lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions (disclaimer p.1)

effective_or_revised: Original Effective Date 08/15/03; Reviewed 07/24/25; Revised 08/15/25 (12 pages)
sections_in_order: Header block (policy number, Original Effective Date, Reviewed, Revised)
criteria_location: Position Statement pp.2-4: standard cochlear implant ALL list; implantation sequencing note; hybrid implant ALL list; programming; replacement/upgrade rules. Reimbursement Information adds replacement coverage conditions; Definitions define severe/profound hearing impairment.

logic.top_level: pathways: standard implant (ALL of 4), hybrid implant (ALL of 4 with nested ALL thresholds), plus conditional statements for programming, replacement, upgrade
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline: 'No contraindications to surgery (e.g., deafness due to lesions of the eighth cranial (acoustic) nerve ..., active or chronic infections ..., cochlear ossification ...)'. Upgrades: 'solely for the purpose of upgrading ... does not meet the definition of medical necessity'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Bilateral-sequential: 'it is not required that hearing tests be repeated between implantation procedures.' Replacement only if 'inadequate response ... or ... no longer functional and cannot be repaired.'

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Unilateral or bilateral severe-to-profound prelingual or postlingual (sensorineural) hearing loss ... defined as a hearing threshold pure-tone average of 70 dB hearing loss or greater at 500, 1000, and 2000 Hz
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Definitions section separately defines 'Severe' as 70-90 dB and 'Profound' as 90 dB and above; criterion repeats threshold inline.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Low-frequency hearing thresholds no poorer than 60 dB hearing level ... AND ... ≥75 dB ... AND ... ≤ 60 dB ... AND ... Aided CNC word recognition score from 10% to 60%
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Four audiometric conditions per ear (implanted vs contralateral); contralateral conditions interleave with the implanted-ear ones.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Replacement of internal and/or external components meets the definition of medical necessity only in those who have inadequate response ... or the component(s) is/are no longer functional
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'only in those who' reads as any-of but 'to the point of interfering with ADLs' modifies only the first.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Procedure and 20+ HCPCS device codes listed; no mapping to criteria, no ICD-10.

vague_terms.quote: failure to develop basic auditory skills

vague_terms.problem: defined parenthetically for adults and children, but in different instruments.

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
Parenthetical definitions with nested parentheses and semicolons span 4-6 lines
Age-split definition ('defined in adults as ... defined in children as ...') inside one bullet
Hybrid threshold bullets use nested 'o' glyphs and the thresholds mix ≥ and ≤ symbols whose encoding must be checked
Definitions section includes 'Perlingual' that is not used in criteria
interesting_structures: Age-banded thresholds (adults vs children) inside one criterion
Audiometric frequency-specific thresholds per ear (ipsilateral vs contralateral)
Hybrid device pathway with different candidacy
Replacement/upgrade rules distinguish need vs convenience

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: ALL-lists with numeric audiometry leaves express well, but the leaves require audiograms and speech scores, age branches inside leaves, and definitions section overlapping thresholds.
